name: write_project_docs
title: Write the project documents
description: Replace text in the project documents as one pushed commit on the default branch. Lessons-only edits need no owner request (never as a guest or approval continuation); decisions or roadmap need an open owner request in the owner's conversation. A queued write reports later by system message.

base_commit.description: The commit read_project_doc returned. A file changed since refuses the call with docs_stale: read it again (retry lessons; show the owner the new text of the other documents).

message.description: The commit subject: one line, English.

old_text.description: The text to replace, exactly as in the file; empty appends at the end of the file.

edits.description: Applied in order, in at most TWO document files (use separate calls for three). Each old_text must occur exactly once. The decision log is append-only: no existing line may change or go; lessons and roadmap may be rewritten. An edit that changes nothing is refused.
